a1.text: The gossip fades when villagers stop repeating it.

a2.text: Curiosity persists, but friends protect the couple's boundaries.

b1.text: The correction ends one rumor without exposing personal details.

c2.text: An offer of company is declined, and (friend) respects that.

d1.text: The former partners clarify only what they choose.
